feedback: I just looked at the behavior with ui=0x10 and the analog outpus ua[2:0] were as expected.

Works better than expected! Vivid VGA images with high colour resolution. For a quick test: Plug in a Tiny VGA PMOD (on uo_out port), apply a 25MHz clock, set ui_in=0x30, and reset. For proper analog output testing, you'll need external buffers (i.e. op-amps) -- see the link to my testing notes and a board design for this.
